summary: The skeleton prints correctly but almost no money reaches the paper: every A/B/C/D amount column in Schedules 2-6 and 10 and Part II items 14-16 prints blank while the saved return holds the values, the tax-rate row prints '0 %'/'. %' fragments, and '0.00' decimals leak into a whole-peso sheet.

defects.what: Total Tax Due/(Overpayment), Total Tax Credits/Payments and Net Tax Payable/(Overpayment) print as empty combs. Stored: item_14 = -1,098,765, item_15 = 81,308,631, item_16 = -82,407,396. Item 21 below them prints the same net figure (8 2 4 0 7 3 9 6) correctly, so the data is there - these three combs are never written.

defects.where: Pages 2-3, all A/B/C/D amount columns (Schedules 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 10)
defects.what: Every money cell of the schedule grids is blank on paper although the stored return carries them (e.g. schedule_3 item 20 = 2,345,678/3,456,789 hand-entered; schedule_5 row 1 = 5,432,109/4,321,098/3,210,987; schedule_6 'OTHERS' row = 55,745,676/88,567,959/75,679,672). Schedule 7.1/8.1 grid cells do print, so the writer covers only part of this form's tables.

defects.where: Page 2 Item 14 Applicable Income Tax Rate; Item 15 and Page 3 Schedule 4 Item 4
defects.what: Tax-rate cells print '0 %', '. %', '. %' - digit fragments plus a stray decimal point with no value. Separately, '0.00' (with centavos) prints in Items 15/16 of Schedule 2 and Schedule 4 Item 4 on a sheet that orders 'DO NOT enter Centavos'.

defects.where: Page 1 Item 8 Registered Name and Item 9 Registered Address
defects.what: Continuation lines are joined without a separator and overflow their ruled lines: '...CONCEPCION DELA CRUZSECOND', '...OVERFLOW CHECKINGSECOND', '...METRO MANILASECOND LINE...' - the second/third line values start mid-line where the previous value ended, words fuse, and the text runs past the comb area into neighbouring cells.
Stored deduction_method = Itemized but neither checkbox is marked - the filer's choice does not reach the sheet.

Row descriptions overflow the Description column into the Legal Basis column ('ROW TXTPG6SC6I1DESCRIPTION - ATTACHED SCHEDULE LINE WITH EX...' runs under 'SEC. 27(C) NIRC 1997 AS AMENDED'); columns are crossed, not clipped.

Rows 2-4 render Description/Legal Basis inputs but their four amount inputs are grey and refuse focus (no amount boxes exist for rows 2+ in the form's field list) - a control that cannot be filled; only row 1 and the attached '(Add more...) rows' list accept amounts.

entered_by_hand: Schedule 3 item 20 fields A = 2,345,678 and B = 3,456,789 typed on the real page (decimal '2345678.91' was refused with 'type a whole number'); ATC Other = IC 010 picked through the dropdown; Save used the toolbar.
open_questions: Schedule 6 attached rows beyond the printed capacity could not be verified on paper because the whole A-D amount columns are blank; row-count truncation is expected per SHARED-FINDINGS but invisible under MX2.
provenance names '1702-MX Jan 2018 ENCS Final with OSDv2.pdf'; not obtainable, so mac/official-p*.png are renders of html-frozen/1702mx-2018c/index.html.
notes: The whole-number entry rule is by design ('DO NOT enter Centavos' on the sheet). My first fill pass used decimal strings that the fields refused - refilled with integers. Stored-side rows whose amounts never had a print counterpart were dropped from the defect list (fill error on my side, e.g. money strings in Legal Basis cells on Schedule 1).
